lessons.title: Prime Factorisation and HCF
lessons.summary: Connect prime factorisation with HCF and LCM.
learning_objectives: Use prime factors to calculate HCF and LCM

content_blocks.text: Every composite number can be expressed as a product of primes. Compare the powers of common primes to find the HCF.
HCF uses the smaller powers; LCM uses the larger powers.

concepts.title: Prime factorisation

questions.explanation: 36 = 2²×3² and 84 = 2²×3×7, so the common product is 12.

chapters.title: Polynomials
chapters.summary: Relate zeroes of a polynomial to its graph and coefficients.
chapters.source_reference: NCERT Mathematics Class X, Chapter 2, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

lessons.title: Reading Zeroes from a Graph
lessons.summary: Interpret x-intercepts as zeroes of a polynomial.
learning_objectives: Verify the relationship between zeroes and coefficients

content_blocks.text: A zero of p(x) is an x-value where p(x) = 0. On a graph, these are the points where the curve meets the x-axis.
For x² − 5x + 6, the zeroes are 2 and 3 because (x − 2)(x − 3) = 0.
The sum of zeroes is −b/a and their product is c/a for ax²+bx+c.

concepts.title: Zeroes
concepts.explanation: Values of x for which a polynomial evaluates to zero.
